title: The Avengers: Earth’s Mightiest Heroes
description: When the powers of a single hero are not enough to save the world, the world’s greatest heroes—Iron Man, Thor, Captain America, The Hulk, Ant-Man/Giant Man and Wasp—assemble to form the Avengers.

episodes.title: S1-E7The Man in the Ant Hill
S2-E1The Private War of Doctor Doom
S2-E8The Ballad of Beta Ray Bill

episodes_data.title: The Avengers: Earth’s Mightiest Heroes 1x1
episodes_data.description: A mass breakout occurs at each of the four supervillain prisons.

episodes_data.title: The Avengers: Earth’s Mightiest Heroes 1x2
episodes_data.description: Ant-Man/Giant-Man, Hulk, Iron Man, Thor and Wasp band together to battle Graviton after he escapes from the Raft and targets Nick Fury.

episodes_data.title: The Avengers: Earth’s Mightiest Heroes 1x3
episodes_data.description: After defeating HYDRA's attack on the United Nations, Iron Man learns that S.H.I.E.L.D. is taking control of his technology.

episodes_data.title: The Avengers: Earth’s Mightiest Heroes 1x4
episodes_data.description: After stopping a robbery attempt by the Wrecking Crew, Thor returns to Asgard in order to defeat Loki and the Frost Giants.

episodes_data.title: The Avengers: Earth’s Mightiest Heroes 1x5
episodes_data.description: The Hulk is hunted by General Ross and the Absorbing Man while Hawkeye discover a conspiracy within SHIELD.

episodes_data.title: The Avengers: Earth’s Mightiest Heroes 1x6
episodes_data.description: Kang the Conqueror observers, while Captain America and the Red Skull battle during World War II.

episodes_data.title: The Avengers: Earth’s Mightiest Heroes 1x7
episodes_data.description: Ant-Man and the Wasp work together to stop Whirlwind. Meanwhile T'Challa's father fights the Man-Ape for control of Wakanda.

episodes_data.title: The Avengers: Earth’s Mightiest Heroes 1x8
episodes_data.description: The Enchantress uses her magic to manipulate the Hulk into distrusting the rest of the Avengers and attacking Thor.

episodes_data.title: The Avengers: Earth’s Mightiest Heroes 1x9
episodes_data.description: The Avengers discover the frozen body of Captain America and revive him, leading Baron Zemo to attack, seeking revenge against Cap for infecting him with Virus X.

episodes_data.title: The Avengers: Earth’s Mightiest Heroes 1x10
episodes_data.description: Furious at Tony Stark for buying up his company, Simon Williams seeks revenge by undergoing a dangerous AIM procedure, overseen by MODOC and the Grim Reaper, Williams' brother, which turns him into a being of pure ion energy.

episodes_data.title: The Avengers: Earth’s Mightiest Heroes 1x11
episodes_data.description: The Black Panther seeks the Avengers' aid in freeing his African nation of Wakanda from usurper king Man-Ape, and stopping Hydra agents Ulysses Klaw and the Grim Reaper from stealing Wakanda's supply of vibranium.

episodes_data.title: The Avengers: Earth’s Mightiest Heroes 1x12
episodes_data.description: When the Leader creates a bubble of gamma radiation emanating from the Cube that mutates any human it touches, the Avengers team up with Doc Sampson to stop him. Meanwhile, Hawkeye infiltrates a Hydra base in order to capture Black Widow.

episodes_data.title: The Avengers: Earth’s Mightiest Heroes 1x13
episodes_data.description: It's up to Hawkeye, the Hulk, and Thor to save the day when the Leader's gamma radiation ray mutates the rest of the Avengers and threatens to do the same to every human on earth.

episodes_data.title: The Avengers: Earth’s Mightiest Heroes 1x14
episodes_data.description: It's Hawkeye, Black Panther, and Ant Man to the rescue when Baron Zemo and his Masters of Evil defeat the rest of the team and take over the Avengers Mansion.

episodes_data.title: The Avengers: Earth’s Mightiest Heroes 1x15
episodes_data.description: The Avengers join forces with Captain Mar-vell in order to prevent a Kree sentry drone from destroying the Earth.

episodes_data.title: The Avengers: Earth’s Mightiest Heroes 1x16
episodes_data.description: Defying the orders of both SHIELD and Iron Man, Hawkeye and Mockingbird allow themselves to be captured by Hydra in an attempt to bring down Black Widow.

episodes_data.title: The Avengers: Earth’s Mightiest Heroes 1x17
episodes_data.description: Kang arrives from the future, claiming he must kill Captain America and conquer the Earth in order to save it from destruction.

episodes_data.title: The Avengers: Earth’s Mightiest Heroes 1x18
episodes_data.description: Kang launches a full-scale invasion of Earth using an army of robots, and in order to save New York, the Avengers are forced to unleash the Ultrons who serve as guards for the Negative Zone Prison.

episodes_data.title: The Avengers: Earth’s Mightiest Heroes 1x19
episodes_data.description: The Avengers board Kang's command ship in order to put an end to his invasion of Earth.

episodes_data.title: The Avengers: Earth’s Mightiest Heroes 1x20
episodes_data.description: Dark elf Malekith the Accursed locates an Asgardian artifact that plunges the Earth into eternal winter.

episodes_data.title: The Avengers: Earth’s Mightiest Heroes 1x21
episodes_data.description: Black Widow turns to the Avengers for help when Hydra and AIM battle over control of the Cosmic Cube.

episodes_data.title: The Avengers: Earth’s Mightiest Heroes 1x22
episodes_data.description: When Ultron-5 goes out of control and kidnaps Wasp, things go crazy when the droid kills Thor with his lasers.

episodes_data.title: The Avengers: Earth’s Mightiest Heroes 1x23
episodes_data.description: Despite Thor going missing and Captain America ending up in the hospital, the Avengers must stop Ultron from eliminating the world's most flawed creatures-humanity.

episodes_data.title: The Avengers: Earth’s Mightiest Heroes 1x24
episodes_data.description: The Masters of Evil take over Earth and Loki double crosses Baron Zemo.

episodes_data.title: The Avengers: Earth’s Mightiest Heroes 1x25
episodes_data.description: Separated across the mythological realms, the Avengers face new threats and make allies for the fight against Loki.

episodes_data.title: The Avengers: Earth’s Mightiest Heroes 1x26
episodes_data.description: Eight of the nine realms of Asgard have fallen, only the Earth remains. The Avengers are all that stands between Loki and total conquest.

episodes_data.title: The Avengers: Earth’s Mightiest Heroes 2x1
episodes_data.description: While playing host to the Fantastic Four at Avengers Mansion, the Avengers find themselves under attack by Doctor Doom's forces.

episodes_data.title: The Avengers: Earth’s Mightiest Heroes 2x2
episodes_data.description: Seeking revenge against Tony Stark, the leader of AIM seizes control of Stark Enterprises' corporate tower.

episodes_data.title: The Avengers: Earth’s Mightiest Heroes 2x3
episodes_data.description: The Enchantress is on a vindictive hunt for Baron von Zemo and he appeals to the Avengers for help against her.

episodes_data.title: The Avengers: Earth’s Mightiest Heroes 2x4
episodes_data.description: Ronan the Accuser of the Kree Empire arrives at Earth with Captain Mar-Vel in tow to pass judgment on whether the planet should be annexed or destroyed.

episodes_data.title: The Avengers: Earth’s Mightiest Heroes 2x5
episodes_data.description: When Henry Pym discovers that his Ant-Man equipment has been stolen and being used by a criminal, he hires Heroes for Hire to recover it.

episodes_data.title: The Avengers: Earth’s Mightiest Heroes 2x6
episodes_data.description: The Avengers receive a man who appears to have been experimented on by aliens, and now hunted by another extraterrestrial group.

episodes_data.title: The Avengers: Earth’s Mightiest Heroes 2x7
episodes_data.description: Iron Man learns from Nick Fury that the Avengers has been infiltrated by a Skrull impostor and the team turns against each other.

episodes_data.title: The Avengers: Earth’s Mightiest Heroes 2x8
episodes_data.description: Thor meets an alien trespasser whose hostility and monstrous appearance belie his unexpected worthiness to wield his hammer, Mjolnir.

episodes_data.title: The Avengers: Earth’s Mightiest Heroes 2x9
episodes_data.description: SHIELD is apparently attacked by the Hulk, but Banner is accounted for elsewhere at the same time while this Hulk is red in color.

episodes_data.title: The Avengers: Earth’s Mightiest Heroes 2x10
episodes_data.description: The real Captain America and his fellow prisoners attempt to escape their Skrull prison.

episodes_data.title: The Avengers: Earth’s Mightiest Heroes 2x11
episodes_data.description: A Skrull team posing as The Avengers invades Wakanda with only Ms. Marvel able to help the Black Panther.

episodes_data.title: The Avengers: Earth’s Mightiest Heroes 2x12
episodes_data.description: The Skrull Empire initiates their seizure of Earth and the Avengers are hard pressed to thwart it.

episodes_data.title: The Avengers: Earth’s Mightiest Heroes 2x13
episodes_data.description: With Captain America's reputation now in tatters, the superhero and the similarly maligned Spider-Man find themselves trying to thwart a prisoner transport interception.

episodes_data.title: The Avengers: Earth’s Mightiest Heroes 2x14
episodes_data.description: Captain America and friends travel to Wakanda to repair his shield, unaware that a powerful android is hunting them to capture it among other objectives.

episodes_data.title: The Avengers: Earth’s Mightiest Heroes 2x15
episodes_data.description: The Enchantress offers Loki a chance to exact his revenge on Thor and the Avengers for thwarting his conquest of the Nine Realms, and uses a spell to strip Thor, Captain America, and Iron Man of their powers. Now, the helpless heroes must defeat Loki - his soul now in command of a powerful Asgardian weapon known as the Destroyer - without their abilities.

episodes_data.title: The Avengers: Earth’s Mightiest Heroes 2x16
episodes_data.description: When an Avenger group visits SHIELD's special prison in the Negative Zone, they soon find themselves under siege by a mysterious enemy.

episodes_data.title: The Avengers: Earth’s Mightiest Heroes 2x17
episodes_data.description: Ultron orders the Vision to lead his android impersonators of the Avengers in capturing the originals.

episodes_data.title: The Avengers: Earth’s Mightiest Heroes 2x18
episodes_data.description: When Henry Pym is apparently killed, a new vigilante using equipment broadly similar to the scientist's is discovered attacking criminals.

episodes_data.title: The Avengers: Earth’s Mightiest Heroes 2x19
episodes_data.description: After a month of being dormant for repairs, The Vision finds the world under the control of Tony Stark.

episodes_data.title: The Avengers: Earth’s Mightiest Heroes 2x20
episodes_data.description: When there is a sudden exposure of a malignant virus around the Avengers mansion, the Secretary of Defense blames the team and lays siege of the headquarters.

episodes_data.title: The Avengers: Earth’s Mightiest Heroes 2x21
episodes_data.description: While dealing with the Red Skull's escape with his Sleeper robots, Captain America also investigates the villain's former henchman who seems disturbingly familiar.

episodes_data.title: The Avengers: Earth’s Mightiest Heroes 2x22
episodes_data.description: With the Hulk apparently rampaging wild, the Red Hulk comes to the Avengers to request to join.

episodes_data.title: The Avengers: Earth’s Mightiest Heroes 2x23
episodes_data.description: When the Avengers are apparently killed by Kang the Conqueror, an automatic function created by Tony Stark calls up several allies up as replacements.

episodes_data.title: The Avengers: Earth’s Mightiest Heroes 2x24
episodes_data.description: As warned, the Kree Empire arrive to threaten Earth.

episodes_data.title: The Avengers: Earth’s Mightiest Heroes 2x25
episodes_data.description: The battle against the Kree Empire continues, with Captain Mar-Vell facing an agonizing moral decision in the conflict.

episodes_data.title: The Avengers: Earth’s Mightiest Heroes 2x26
episodes_data.description: The Avengers and his allies face the ultimate test when Galactus, the Devourer of Planets comes to consume Earth.
